description: The atlas's own composite ranking. Computed by scripts/score.py from data/indicators only; no model writes or adjusts a score. Every choice below is a published, adjustable assumption.

sensitivity.note: Domain weights are redrawn at random (uniform over all weightings) to show how far each rank depends on the weighting choice.

domains.label: Coverage
domains.question: Is everyone covered, and do they get essential services?

domains.label: Financial protection
domains.question: Are people protected from ruinous health costs?
domains.note: Out-of-pocket share counts double because it is current for every country; the WHO household-survey measures are often years old or missing.

domains.label: Health outcomes
domains.question: Does the system keep people alive and healthy?

not_yet_scored.reason: Needs comparable data on gaps between income groups for every country.
Needs comparable waiting-time and unmet-need data beyond the EU and the Commonwealth Fund's 10 countries.
Shown separately as the score against spending per person, not folded into the score, so cost and performance can be read apart.

excluded_countries.TWN: Not covered by World Bank, WHO or OECD statistics; needs official Taiwanese data on the same definitions.
